name: Mairsil — only cards you own in exile with cage counters
notes: Memory: project_mairsil_exile_owner_filter_2026-04-28 (and exile_zone_implementation). The 'you own' in Mairsil's text was discarded, so cards owned by the opponent were included. exile_1 is Elves (owned by p1, cage counter): gained. exile_2 is Birds (owned by the opponent, cage counter): must NOT be gained. exile_3 is Sol Ring (owned by p1, no cage counter): must NOT be gained. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build this recipe in its own process so nextExileId starts at 1.

$excludes: {T}: Add one mana of any color.
